envVars.name: LIVETENNIS_API_KEY
envVars.description: Live Tennis API key. The FREE tier is enough for this gate — get one at https://livetennisapi.com/subscribe/free

envVars.name: SIMMER_API_KEY
envVars.description: Simmer SDK key. Only needed for --live-data, which lists real Polymarket tennis markets to gate. The gate itself does not trade.

envVars.name: LIVETENNIS_BASE_URL
envVars.description: Override the Live Tennis API base URL (default https://api.livetennisapi.com/api/public/v1).
